thread:
mina: Confidential heads-up 1: my elderly parent had a sudden procedure and I need to care for them for ~10 days. Im hoping for a short-term compressed schedule (4x10s) and an on-call pause. Whats the best way to document this without it going broadly visible?

carla (People Ops): Sorry to hear that, @mina. We can absolutely help. Best practice: submit the "Temporary Schedule Accommodation" form so we have a confidential record, and well coordinate with your manager for on-call and coverage. We keep medical details private.

ty (Manager): Im happy to approve a 4x10 for the 10 days and remove you from the pager rotation. Mina, can you confirm which dates and whether youll be reachable for urgent messages? We can also shift deadlines if needed.

mina: Thanks, Ty. Dates are 2278901400 22 10 days. Id prefer not to be paged unless it's a P0. I can check Slack morning and evening. Also worried about my upcoming mid-cycle check-in 1: will this affect any ratings?

carla (People Ops): Good question. Temporary accommodations for caregiving are not held against performance. We can add a private note in your review file clarifying the accommodation window so reviewers have context. If youd like, People Ops can also flag the mid-cycle check-in for manager context only.

scheduler_bot: Reminder: link to form https://redwood.internal/forms/temp-schedule. Submitting creates a private HR case and notifies only People Ops and your manager.

ty (Manager): Approved: on-call pause and 4x10 schedule for the 10-day window. Ill update rota and deadlines. Mina, Ill also add a manager note for the mid-cycle check-in so your reviewer knows this was temporary. No change to your goals unless we explicitly agree.

mina: Appreciate it. Ill submit the form and DM Carla the dates. Thank you both for being flexible and keeping this confidential.

carla (People Ops): Received your DM. Ive opened a confidential case (caregiving: compressed schedule + on-call pause) with start 2278901400 and planned end 2279064200. We set a 1-week check-in to see if extension needed. Notifications to People Ops and Ty only.

mina: Thanks again. That eases a lot of stress. Ill update if anything changes.
